name: Sendan
source:
Sendan is the leader of Kaoru's pack of Inukami. She seems strict and demanding, but appears so because she seems to have the well-being of her contractor and master at heart at all times. Only perfect service is good enough for 'Kaoru-sama'. Sendan is the younger sister of Hake, the male Inukami that serves the head of the Kawahira family. Like her older brother, she always carries around a fan.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Inukami!_characters]Wikipedia[/url]. ]
